confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for Rhodes in July 2026 (peak season), not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain because July hotel rates vary widely by district and availability, so hostel and hotel anchors are wider bands. Beer and cocktail prices are also uncertain because venue pricing in the Old Town and seafront varies. FX provenance: the 15 October 2026 figure comes from a search-result summary of the RBA overview page. I did not open the RBA table directly, so the value is not independently verified against the RBA's own table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Greek island resort towns in high season, such as Heraklion and Corfu Town, adjusted for Rhodes's large tourist flow. Prices reflect ordinary tavernas, cafés and registered accommodation, not waterfront or luxury venues. No web search was used for the city-price anchors.
